answer.source: NASA MODIS Terra Vegetation Indices, 16-day, 250 m (MOD13Q1), shown through NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services
answer.units: NDVI (greenness) of the land round the field, the median of a patch about 2 km across: 0 is bare ground or dead plants and about 0.8 is thick healthy green; one value a season, its greenest 16-day reading
answer.note: How green the land round the field looked at its greenest each season, from NASA's satellite record since 2001: the median of a patch about 2 km across, not the field alone. A season with too few clear readings is left out and named, never counted as brown.
answer.incomplete: 167 readings of the older seasons could not be made in time or just now; no greenness for 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014
